title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Saturday, 21 November 2026
description: The US tightens AI chip export rules to close an overseas data-centre loophole, fresh ABS figures show the strongest quarterly wage growth in years, Robert Irwin is named Queensland's 2027 Australian of the Year, and teenage surfing world champion Leihani Zoric arrives on the Gold Coast. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
